original_content_full:
GraphicsMedia.net workshop hosted by the HPI

On September 8 and 9, the HPI hosted the strategy workshop of Graphics Media.net, an international organization that aims to foster applied research in the areas of computer graphics, multimodal-multimedia technologies, and visual interactive digital media technologies. More than 20 researchers from five partner organizations joined the meeting and had fruitful discussions on future directions of the network and, especially, on collaboration among the partners.
